name: web-dark-flowing-line-field-background-with-theme-and-refresh-buttons
title: Black field of thin grey flow lines sweeping from left to lower right, with three small icon buttons at the top right
whatItIs: A near-black canvas with many fine grey curved lines sweeping across like long-exposure star trails, and three small bordered icon buttons (theme, refresh, panel) at the top right.
whatItMeans: Calm and generative; thin lines suggest movement and depth.
techniques: Draw many thin lines following one flow.

vocabulary.definition: Long thin arcs like a long exposure.
An image produced by rules or code.
A small square button with an icon.
